C0298.title: Runtime Detection of CPU-Exhaustion DoS Attacks
C0298.summary: A 2022 IEEE Transactions on Services Computing paper proposed Coda, a framework that detects application-layer CPU-exhaustion DoS attacks by modeling and monitoring CPU time consumed by requests in containers. These attacks use a small number of crafted requests to trigger algorithmic or implementation weaknesses, differing from traditional high-volume denial-of-service attacks.
